summary: MongoDB Migration Testing - PASSED (100% Backend, 95% Frontend). Verified products and recipes now load from MongoDB collections (products_de: 30, products_it: 61, recipes: 30) instead of static JSON files. All 20 backend API tests passed. E2E frontend flow works correctly - symptom analysis returns products with MongoDB-sourced data (images, prices, ratings). Recipe filtering by symptom_tags working.

integration_issues.flow: Italian language switch on home screen
integration_issues.issue: Pre-existing issue from iteration_7: Language switch button on home screen doesn't immediately update UI. Works when set from disclaimer screen.
integration_issues.workaround: Set language from disclaimer screen before accepting

critical_code_review_comments: MongoDB migration properly implemented - products_de, products_it, recipes collections populated and indexed
products.py correctly excludes MongoDB _id from responses
Dynamic prompts (prompts.py) properly load catalog from MongoDB for LLM context
Analysis endpoint enriches brand_products with MongoDB catalog data (image_url, price, rating)
Recipe filtering by symptom_tags works correctly with MongoDB queries

seed_data_creation: MongoDB collections already populated by migration script: products_de (30), products_it (61), recipes (30)
context_for_next_testing_agent: MongoDB MIGRATION VERIFIED. Products and recipes now loaded from MongoDB instead of JSON files. Key collections: products_de (30 items), products_it (61 items), recipes (30 bilingual items). Backend endpoints tested: GET /api/products?lang=de/it, GET /api/products/{id}, GET /api/recipes?lang=de/it, GET /api/recipes/{id}, POST /api/symptoms/analyze (uses MongoDB catalog for LLM prompts), POST /api/track/click. All working correctly.

products_de_mongodb.details: GET /api/products?lang=de returns 30 products from MongoDB with all fields (product_id, name, description, affiliate_url, tags, price, image_url, rating)

products_it_mongodb.details: GET /api/products?lang=it returns 61 Italian products from MongoDB with video_url field

single_product_lookup.details: GET /api/products/{product_id} works for both DE and IT, returns proper error for invalid IDs

products_tag_filtering.details: Products can be filtered by tags (e.g., gelenke) using MongoDB $elemMatch query

recipes_mongodb.details: GET /api/recipes returns 30 bilingual recipes from MongoDB with proper localization (de/it)

recipe_symptom_filtering.details: Recipes can be filtered by symptom_tags (e.g., müdigkeit)

single_recipe_lookup.details: GET /api/recipes/{recipe_id} works with proper language localization

analysis_with_mongodb_catalog.details: POST /api/symptoms/analyze uses get_system_prompt() which loads catalog from MongoDB. brand_products enriched with catalog data (image_url, price, rating, affiliate_url)

dynamic_prompts.details: prompts.py get_system_prompt() dynamically loads product catalog from MongoDB for LLM context

affiliate_tracking.details: POST /api/track/click still works correctly for tracking click events

e2e_frontend_flow.details: Full flow: Disclaimer→Home→Symptom input→Analyze→Results with products and recipes from MongoDB. Product cards show image, price, rating from MongoDB catalog

mongodb_verification.data_integrity: All documents have required fields, _id excluded from API responses
